insights.one_liner: Angi is a US platform matching homeowners with home service pros, with an English-language entry-level marketing job in Amsterdam and a new CEO.

culture.text: About 3,277 people on LinkedIn, mainly in sales, operations, business development and engineering.
Staff often studied business, computer science or marketing, many at Indiana universities.
Says it values diverse backgrounds, and may use AI tools in candidate screening alongside human decisions.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an entry-level marketing role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Reported a per-share loss in Q2 2026, far below estimates.
Is pivoting to an AI-driven platform and was among the first brands to pilot sponsored agents in ChatGPT.

worth_knowing.text: Named Michael Steib CEO, replacing Jeff Kip after two years, as the company pivots to AI.
Will present an AI roadmap at an investor day in New York on 17 November 2026.
